title: Red Card Offenses
summary: A red card means a player or official is sent off and must leave the pitch area. This happens for serious misconduct, dangerous play, or breaking specific rules.
conditions: Player or official commits a specific sending-off offence
Offence occurs between pre-match inspection and match end
Offence meets criteria for serious foul play or violent conduct
Offence denies an obvious goal-scoring opportunity
Player receives a second yellow card in one match
